data.name: Ironblood
data.detailed_description:
Ironblood is a dark fantasy turn-based RPG where your choices shape the fate of an entire kingdom.

The Story

Play as Hikari, a young boy living under the iron fist of a tyrannical king. After witnessing a devastating tragedy, Hikari sets out on a journey of vengeance, loss and redemption across the kingdom of Valdris. Every decision you make will determine whether peace or bloodshed follows in your wake.

Gameplay

• Turn-based combat with real-time elements — dodge incoming attacks with your shield while choosing your next move

• A unique Act system allows you to talk, reason, compliment or insult your opponents — most battles can be resolved without violence

• Form Alliances with enemies to spare them and change the story

• Explore towns, interact with NPCs and uncover the secrets of Valdris

Features

• A handcrafted pixel art world with original characters and story

• Multiple routes through each encounter — fight or find a peaceful solution

• An emotionally driven narrative with dark themes and unexpected twists

• Original soundtrack

• A single save slot system tracking your playtime and inventory

How long is the game?

Ironblood is currently in development with more content being added regularly.

Will you liberate the kingdom? Or let your fury consume you…

content_descriptors.notes: It's a game set in the medieval times, and despite it being a pixel top down game, there will be some scenes of blood and death to indicate how bad the kingdom is run. You also interact with people who have lossed loved ones to the king and have been through a horrific time, which is used to resonate with them as the beginning scene your mother is murdered by the kings guard.
